isolation: SEPARATE corpus. These events are NOT in MoreTestingMaybeFiles.ALL_EVENTS and their CSVs are NOT under data/ — by brief. Files here: maps_<id>.csv, series_<id>.csv, match_results_prefranchise.csv.
caveats: Map-pool / patch regime discontinuity: 2021-2022 was pre-franchising Valorant on old patches (pre 5.x metas), with maps entering/leaving the pool (Fracture added 2021-09, Pearl added 2022-06, Split removed 2022 etc.) and agents that reshaped map identities. Map-level parameters learned on 2023+ do NOT transfer; treat these blocks as a separate regime for any fit.

Org continuity: many 2021-22 orgs do not exist in the franchised era (Gambit, Acend, OpTic, XSET, FPX-EMEA...) or changed regions. Org abbreviations here must not be joined against BuildMapRatings.TEAM_REGIONS.
vct_only filtering intentionally OFF for this corpus (participants predate the franchise org list).

Winners verified mechanically per series (map winner in map-row orgs; series score equals per-map tally; date inside window) + a seed-20260728 10-series live re-fetch sample per event; see testing_lab/v8/stats/verification_report.json.
